rationale: Tests whether a new architecture/resolution configuration adds complementary predictions to the known winner.
Uses a moderate 25% new-model weight as an exploratory trial, not a proxy error-count optimum.
Clean and flip-averaged 25% additions tie on proxy errors; TTA has marginally lower proxy NLL, which is weak exploratory evidence.
New standalone model is weaker than the existing same-split models, and proxy NLL worsens when it is added.
Neither fewer disagreements nor the proxy improvement establishes better public or private accuracy.
